result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, but requires crossing a wide multi-lane arterial without a refuge island. The environment is dominated by commercial land use with wide lane geometries that likely encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded asphalt in the intersection to provide a smooth, level walking surface.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-capacity arterial intersection with multiple travel lanes and a wide grassy median. While a high-visibility crosswalk is present for a side-turn lane, the main roadway lacks visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure, resulting in a high-exposure environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The main roadway features at least six travel lanes, creating a long, unprotected distance for pedestrians to traverse without a marked crossing or refuge.

hazards.name: High-Speed Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight lanes and large turning radii are designed for high-speed vehicle throughput, which is inherently hazardous to pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals for all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised, accessible refuge islands within the median to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce crossing distances and slow turning traffic.

result.summary: The image depicts a sprawling, multi-lane arterial intersection dominated by vehicle traffic and lacking basic pedestrian safety infrastructure. There are no visible crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or sidewalks, creating a high-exposure environment with long crossing distances.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at this large intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire intersection foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without any refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The main roadway spanning the width of the image.

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated signals are visible to provide pedestrians with a protected phase to cross the multi-lane road.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners and overhead signal mast arms.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve predictability.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and reduce exposure.

result.summary: The image shows a wide commercial arterial road with a marked zebra crosswalk and a sidewalk on the right side. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic signals are present, the long crossing distance across multiple lanes without a refuge island creates a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.
